what: Master Version 2.54 — the 5979 BS-1 Replacement Electron Tube and the four Helios rows (861 v1 Helios 21, 861 v2 Helios 21 Sears No. 79 N 5871CM, 866 Helios Anti-Gravity Booster, 867 Helios Control Panel Production Sample) MOVE from Lionel PW - Items to Lionel PW - Other, so every item from COTT's Other Items page lives on the tab for Lionel's non-train products and shows in the Master Catalog's Other section. Each row keeps every field and its Row ID; PW - Other has no Category / Track Power / MSRP / Body Color columns, so 867's Body Color "green, blue (photo)" goes into its Notes. Copy first (bottom of PW - Other), verify cell for cell, then remove the five PW - Items rows. Brad owns none (checked 2026-10-17).
stated: Brad (2026-10-17): "yes" to looking at the move, then "approve the delete"
planReadAt: public CSV export of Lionel PW - Items and PW - Other, read 2026-10-17 right before this record
